rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize ST20 test parameters (fill threshold, leak limit, overpressure limit)
Detect transmitter wire-break condition (pressure < -500)
Latch overpressure alarm when pressure exceeds maximum threshold
Latch supply air pressure low alarm while station is running sequence
Reset latched alarms when fault reset pushbutton is pressed
Summarize common fault alarm and energize ST20 fault beacon
Manual vent valve control when station is not in auto mode
Start ST20 auto sequence on pallet arrival when no faults active
Transition from clamp step to fill step upon clamp closed verification
Run fill timeout timer during fill step
Latch fill timeout alarm if fill timer expires
Transition from fill step to stabilise step when target pressure reached
Run settle / stabilisation timer during stabilise step
Capture initial test pressure sample at end of test window
Transition from stabilise step to test step when timer elapses
Run test window timer during leak measurement step
Capture final pressure and calculate pressure decay value
Evaluate leak test result against limit and latch PASS or FAIL flag
Transition from test step to vent step when test timer elapses
Abort active test sequence and transition to vent step on station fault
Run vent timer during vent step
Transition from vent to unclamp step once timer expires and pack is vented
Transition from unclamp step to complete step when clamp open verified
Clear sequence busy and step complete flags when pallet departs
Energize clamp solenoid during clamp, fill, stabilise, test, and vent steps
Energize fill valve during fill step when station is fault-free
Open vent valve during vent step or on overpressure condition
Signal PASS or FAIL result to line controller during complete step
End of program scan
